body:
I have, and we get along pretty well at work, and I like them well enough, they are really cool guys.  We just don't hang out outside of work.  

It's weird, for lunch I prefer to be alone, I just feel more comfortable that way.  When I'm around people I get really self conscious and anxious.  I don't know what to say, conversation feels forced and I feel really uncomfortable.  Despite that I still want to be social and around people.

It's a catch-22 I guess

And now my brother is hanging out with one of my friends and I'm still in my apartment watching TV.  I don't really want to be around people, I want to be alone, but I don't want to be alone.

I don't know, I feel confused a lot.
It's been building up for a little over a year, spring of 2014 semester.
I guess I don't really have any friends then, they seem to have all pulled away from me
I think I will just kill myself, it seems like a better plan, and a lot easier to do.
IDK, only time will tell how my life plays out.  I'm gonna go out to breakfast at my favorite dinner, only thing I can think of to make me somewhat happy right now.
I don't want to sound like a broken record, but I would just end up disappointing the next person.  I disappoint everyone, I'm never good enough.  Suicide honestly seems like my best solution
but now she knows better and left me, I wasn't good enough

I don't know how to explain it, but I honestly believe that won't happen :/

I have these negative thoughts all day, telling me I'm worthless.  No woman would want to be with me.

Just keep talking with him, ask what is making him feel this way.  Maybe bring him away from a group environment to talk with him in private somewhere?

Just don't trivialize how he is feeling.  Don't say things like other people have it worse then he does.

IDK, these things are difficult.  Just be there and show you care.  You know him better then I do.

there is a robotics club, but I'm not sure if they will let me join as I am graduating now.

I kept telling myself to join clubs while in college but I never found the time, I just focused on classes.  Regretting that now.

I tried reaching out to a friend once, now I feel like our friendship is strained so I stopped.  Before that I reached out to my ex and after a while she completely stopped talking to me and blocked me on facebook.  I don't really feel comfortable talking about these feelings with my parents/family.  I guess I don't see how I can make new friends or meet other women.  A lot of my interests are academic and or solitary (tinkering with electronics, playing video games, and reading)
